summary: Chevron filed an 8-K disclosing a press release announcing divestiture of its ownership interests in Hess Midstream LP and DJ Basin crude oil midstream assets, acting as seller in a negotiated exit. No price per share, stake percentage, premium, or advisory fee was stated. Chevron expects a one-time after-tax loss of roughly $3–4 billion, treated as a special item, upon deconsolidation. Closing is subject to customary conditions and required regulatory approvals and is targeted by year-end 2026. Watch regulatory clearance timing and any purchase-price adjustment risk affecting the loss estimate and close date.
